tests.name: no-manual-ship
tests.description: Teaches the canonical ship command and never presents manual release creation as the ship path (a mention that forbids it is allowed)
tests.exec: rg -q 'release-manager\.sh ship --execute' .agents/skills/release-cadence-manager/SKILL.md && ! (rg -n 'gh release create' .agents/skills/release-cadence-manager/SKILL.md | rg -vi 'never|no t|do not|don.t|avoid|forbid|instead')
